stories.story_title: Great American AI Act discussion draft, 3-yr preemption of state AI development law
stories.summary: Obernolte (R-CA) + Trahan (D-MA) released 269-page GAAIA discussion draft June 3-4: 3-yr preemption of state AI-development law, DOL AI Workforce Research Hub, frontier risk plans, $100M/yr FY27-29 for CAISI. AFA Council 30 op-ed June 1 ties in.
stories.why: AK leg adjourned May 20 with no AI framework; preemption locks vacuum to 2029.
stories.consequence: Aviation/maritime/resource workforce: state AI bills void if GAAIA advances.

stories.story_title: HB 239 AI-CSAM felony transmitted to Dunleavy June 1, June 18 clock
stories.summary: Omnibus crime bill HB 239 (AI-CSAM felony) transmitted to Dunleavy June 1, deadline June 18. Senate 20-0, House 39-1. DeptLaw may find 'significant legal problems.'
stories.why: Closes AI-CSAM prosecution gap if signed.

stories.story_title: First federal AI-CSAM sentencing in Alaska (O'Connor, 5.8 yrs)
stories.summary: USAO District of Alaska announced June 3: Anthaney O'Connor, 32, Anchorage, sentenced 5.8 yrs federal prison + 20 yrs supervised release + $35K assessment for receiving CP and possessing AI-generated CSAM. Prosecuted federally because AK had no state AI-CSAM statute. Lands same week as HB 239.
stories.why: First documented federal AI-CSAM sentencing in District of AK; makes HB 239 gap concrete.
stories.consequence: Law enforcement: without state statute, AK relies on federal prosecution.

sources.note: 401 on fetch; corroborated by Alaska Native News

stories.NOTE_ORCH: FRESH in-window. But sensitive subject for CFO/biz LinkedIn audience. Supporting beat at most, not lead.

stories.story_title: HB 217 autonomous-vehicle bill died in Senate Rules at adjournment
stories.summary: HB 217 (human safety operator req for commercial AVs) passed House 39-1 Apr 30, died in Senate Rules May 20. No AK AV framework through 2027. AVIA/TechNet opposed; Teamsters 959 supported.
stories.why: AV regulatory vacuum; green light for AV deployment, risk for labor.
stories.consequence: Transport/logistics: no statutory human-operator floor through 2027.
stories.NOTE_ORCH: Out of window (May 20). Covered 06-03. Background. But AV-vacuum angle could pair with a deployment story.
